{{# Replicator fieldtype (App\Fieldtypes\Replicator) on public forms (UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#675). App\Fieldtypes\Replicator::preProcessTagRenderable() renders each set's subfields by dotting their handle under the field + row index, so the form tag emits the nested input name `{{ handle }}[{index}][{subfield}]` that Statamic\Fieldtypes\Replicator::process() consumes (flat subfields per row, alongside `type`/`enabled`). Existing/old-input rows render at concrete indices; one blank `
